subject: [PATCH 5/6] NFSD: Count the storage reads of each export's READs

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch adds a new counter to track the storage reads of each export in NFS, which is essential for determining the optimal I/O mode for an export. The current implementation only reports bytes returned by READ operations, but this can be misleading as it includes page cache hits and other factors. To address this issue, the patch introduces a new io_read_storage counter that captures the actual storage reads initiated by each export's READ operations. This counter is only visible when CONFIG_TASK_IO_ACCOUNTING is enabled. The patch modifies several files to implement this new feature, including export.c, export.h, stats.h, and vfs.c.
